prose_preference.before: Lord, we pray, attend to our prayers with loving favor, so that, as we receive Your gifts amid tribulation, we may grow in love for You through our consolation. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
